> 咸。亨，利貞。取女吉。

Hexagram 31 begins the lower half, and its name is chosen with a precision that is easy to miss.

## 咸 means "all," and 感 is its child

說文: 咸，皆也，悉也 — all, entirely. That is the original sense, and it is not "feeling."

Three layers:

1. The shape: 咸 means all, every.
2. The borrowing: the 易 uses 咸 for 感 — and the 彖's first sentence does exactly that: 咸，感也.
3. The root — and this is the important one: 說文, 感，動人心也。從心，咸聲.

So 感 is a phonetic compound on 心, with 咸 as its sound.

Which makes the choice of the name a statement: 感 carries a heart, and the 易 uses the version without one.

Not an accident. Among a set of words, choosing 感 would have been available and 咸 was chosen instead — so the feeling here has no heart in it.

(A discipline: this is a reading out of the relationship between the characters, not a claim that 咸 itself means "feeling without a heart." Character source and doctrine stay in separate layers.)

## 咸其拇: the sensation starts at the toe

The six lines are one body, from the bottom up.

拇: the big toe. The sensation first stirs, barely.

腓: the calf — the part that moves readily. Now the limb is pulled, and it is easy to go outward.

股: the thigh, which follows the foot and has no will of its own. 執其隨 — clinging to what it follows, unable to be independent.

脢: the flesh along the spine, behind the heart.

輔、頰、舌: the cheeks and the tongue — the organs of argument. Here the response is sought by talking.

So the hexagram maps a single movement of feeling through a body and arrives at the mouth: the last line is where feeling is manufactured by speech.

## 憧憧往來，朋從爾思

九四: 憧憧 — the mind stirring, back and forth, thinking and planning without pause. Seeking a response by thinking about it.

And the line's verdict: 貞吉，悔亡 — but the friends follow your thoughts.

Which is a very exact description of a certain kind of relation: it works, and what it produces is people who respond to your thinking rather than to you.

## 虛受人

The 象: 君子以虛受人.

Empty the inside, hold no fixed preconception, and then another person can be received.

虛 is not blankness. It is the absence of a pre-formed self standing in the doorway.

## The test

Take a conversation you are trying to make land. Ask where the movement started — at the toe, in the calf, in the thigh, along the spine, or in the mouth. The hexagram's order is the argument: the later the sensation starts, the less of it there is.
